note: Trigger-routing suite. expect=trigger: the skill should fire on the prompt in a fresh session; expect=no-trigger: a near-miss owned elsewhere. Minted 2026-07-18 when doc-forge converted from command species to procedural species (disable-model-invocation: true -> false) — closing the gap where doc-review, bug-report, feature, and issue already fenced 'NOT for drafting/other document types (doc-forge)' but doc-forge itself was invisible to auto-discovery. Positives drawn from the exact near-miss prompts doc-authoring-standards, feature, and grill-the-ask's own suites already reserve for doc-forge. Negatives are those siblings' own trigger territory, adversarially reused here.
